description: Account-wide Renovate policy: one weekly pull request per repository for minor and patch updates, merged when CI passes; security fixes at once; majors wait for review.

packageRules.description: Minor and patch updates: one weekly group, merged once CI passes and each release is three days old
Major updates: one pull request each, never merged automatically
Terraform version constraints stay as written; only the lock file moves
Git dependencies pinned to a commit carry our own patches; moving the pin to a branch head drops them
egui and winit come from the crmne/egui and crmne/winit forks, which have to be ported before any app moves
fastframe crates release together and must move together
